body: 20:27: Lane 3 (confirm-and-picker-sheets, today-mood-dock) reported failed with exit 0. All lib work is done, and 7 of its 8 acceptance tests pass and were red at HEAD. The 8th, test/design/feedback/confirm_sheet_test.dart, had a hook-locked test bug: `_useSurface` never cleared the phone view padding for the macOS half. Handoff: handoff/proto-phone-shell-lane-3.md.U+000AU+000AU+002D I added an `else { tester.view.resetPadding(); tester.view.resetViewPadding(); }` in `_useSurface` in the run worktree (uncommitted). Analyze is clean and the test passes.U+000AU+002D Lane 8 (phone-search) is the only Worker running. Lane 9 (needs 3) and Lane 10 (needs 3 and 7) are blocked, so the run exits after Lane 8. Then flip lanes "3" and "7" to held, with a note that the orchestrator fixed each Lane's hook-locked test, and `run.zsh 1 --resume`. That lands both and runs Lanes 9 and 10.U+000AU+000ADesign notes from Lane 3 for the PR body:U+000AU+002D showConfirmDialog gains optional cancelLabel, confirmKey and cancelKey.U+000AU+002D PhoneSheetButton is public in confirm_dialog.dart.U+000AU+002D The confirm sheet's Cancel autofocuses.U+000AU+002D The phone select sheet has no title.U+000AU+002D changeMoodForDate returns MoodChangeOutcome. A dock failure shows as a toast.U+000AU+002D The dock is at least 60 tall and grows with large text; app_text_scale_test caught the overflow.U+000AU+002D The 80-point toast lift is registered only while the dock card is mounted.U+000AU+000AExisting tests Lane 3 breaks, for the post-wave-1 fix-up:U+000A1U+002E test/features/settings/widgets/delete_all_dialog_test.dart (3 tests): give its MaterialApp `theme: ThemeData(platform: TargetPlatform.macOS)`. No Lane owns it.U+000A2U+002E test/accessibility/dark_walkthrough_test.dart 'the mood picker draws dark' (android variant): tap 'How are you feeling?' when the layout platform is android, and `_moodQuestion` otherwise. No Lane owns it; Lane 7's notes also touch this file.U+000A3U+002E test/features/onboarding/onboarding_finish_test.dart 'today shows the onboarding mood and exactly one log with the typed line' (bottom bar): on the phone, read the mood from TodayMoodDock ('Feeling Grateful'), not MoodBanner. This file is in wave 2's onboarding-frame write-set, so add this to that Step's task during the wave 2 audit, or fix it on the shell branch and tell the onboarding Step.U+000A4U+002E Lane 10 owns the settings_sweep b4/b5 and settings baseline, reading_order b4 and dialog_fixes_test failures.
